meta.title: فرض الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية (النموذج 2)
topics: the present simple: questions with do / does

paper:
Ali is thirteen. On Fridays, he usually gets up at nine o'clock. After breakfast, he goes to the mosque with his father. In the afternoon, he often plays football with his friends in the stadium. He never watches TV for a long time. On Saturdays, he does his homework and helps his mother. In the evening, he sometimes reads a story before he goes to bed.

(Text written by the site)

A. Reading comprehension (8 points)

1. True or false? a) Ali gets up at seven on Fridays. b) He plays football in the afternoon. c) He watches TV a lot.

2. Answer: a) Where does Ali go after breakfast? b) What does he do on Saturdays?

B. Mastery of language (6 points)

1. Ask questions about the underlined words: a) Ali gets up at nine o'clock. b) He plays football in the stadium.

2. Put the verbs in the present simple: My sister (to go) to school by bus. We (not / to play) on Mondays.

3. Write the time in letters: 07:30 → … ; 10:15 → …

C. Written expression (6 points)

Describe your weekend in 5 or 6 sentences. Use: usually, often, sometimes, never.
